title: Vibrant Brazilian Cheese Toast
description: A tangy and cheesy Brazilian dish featuring Shaoxing wine, perfect for a brunch mood, served in a copper mug. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional cheese toast.

ingredients.name: shaoxing wine
ingredients.notes: or substitute with dry white wine

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together Shaoxing wine and lemon juice.
Brush the coconut oil onto each slice of whole wheat bread.
Place the bread slices onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the shredded Brazilian cheese evenly over the bread slices.
Drizzle the Shaoxing wine mixture over the cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately in a copper mug.
